memo: First LB test of our de novo part (risk taken on purpose: user 10-12). Same CPU build as e2b-2 (0.381: public 0.420 base + our fp2 + MMP 100 / >=1 context, GPU week used up) plus ours_denovo: dn1 (our formula-constrained atom-token SMILES generator, dn1-1b weights; base idea: the organisers' casmi-denovo-tutorial-notebook) decodes under the top formulas of pass 1, products are deduped and ordered by our fp2 log-likelihood, top 20 per molecule enter through the PubChem merge, pass 2 rescores (ranker, ICE/GLACIER, fusion). CPU: 16 samples per spectrum, 150 min cap, fall back to pass 1 on any error. Offline: truth generated 0.088-0.124 of held-out NP molecules, fp order puts 7 of 11 at rank 1. Hypothesis: LB > e2b-2 0.381 (de novo reaches hidden class-3 molecules that no list holds).
message: e2dn-1: e2b-2 CPU build + our dn1 de novo (top 20 by fp2, 16 samples/spectrum). Hypothesis: LB > 0.381
